name: GP de Fourmies / La Voix du Nord

intermediate.name: 1st passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (146.3 km)

story: The 2026 GP de Fourmies, held in wet conditions, saw numerous crashes. Many riders attempted breakaways, but the race concluded with a sprint finish, which included two more falls. Arvid De Kleijn secured his first victory of the year ahead of Müller and Vernon.
